key_insight: The paper trains an attention graph neural network directly from finite-volume residuals, enabling label-free surrogate modeling of coupled thermo-fluid fields.
engineering_relevance: This reduces the need for expensive CFD data generation while preserving physically consistent predictions for steady and transient thermal-fluid simulations.
method: Compute FVM residuals of the governing equations on the mesh as the training loss.
Train an attention graph neural network without labeled field data.
Evaluate against CFD references and a data-supervised baseline on steady and parametric transient cases.
evidence_signal: Across four scenarios, the FVM-loss model achieved 2.3–2.8% all-field nRMSE on the steady benchmarks and outperformed the supervised baseline on the transient cases.
watch_item: Residual-based training depends on accurate discretization, mesh quality, and stable optimization; performance may vary for more complex geometries or poorly conditioned coupled physics.
paper_title: Label-Free Finite-Volume-Residual Training of Attention Graph Neural Networks for Coupled Thermo-Fluid Fields
